description: Converts a document, an image, an e-book or a web page saved as a file to PDF: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, Apple Pages, RTF, TXT, CSV, PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, HEIC, EPUB, PostScript (PS, EPS) and HTML. The converter is chosen from the extension of the file. An HTML file is printed as a browser would print it. The file is uploaded to conv2pdf and the call counts as one conversion.

input_path.description: Path of the file on this computer: absolute, or relative to the working directory of the server.

output_path.description: Where to write the result. Optional: by default next to the input file, under a name that is not taken. An existing file is never overwritten.

name: convert_to_pdf
title: Convert to PDF
